caption: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed an executive order Friday directing the state to convene an expert group with a two-month window to deliver concrete AI safety recommendations — recommendations that could become state law. The three proposals on the table are significant: a kill-switch mechanism giving the state authority to shut down frontier AI models deemed unsafe, mandatory onsite embeds of independent auditors inside AI companies, and transparency reports held to third-party auditor standards rather than self-certification. The source reporting on this order is early-stage and thin on final legislative language, so treat the mandate as in-motion, not settled. California is the world's fifth-largest economy.
